title: dryopteris mutica
intro: Dryopteris mutica, commonly known as Aspidium glaucum or Wood fern, is a species of flowering plant in the family Dryopteridaceae. It is a type of fern that has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Dryopteris mutica include wound healing, antiviral, and antibacterial activities, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins. The health benefits of this plant may include reducing inflammation, protecting against oxidative stress, and modulating the immune system.
